title: Ubuntfu
author: Lumni
content:
# Ubuntfu

Emkhatsini wemaganga lamanyenti, kwakunekaya la kwakuhlala khona bantfu labanyenti. Bakuleso sigodzi babewati kahle umtsetfo weUbuntfu — kutsi umuntfu ngumuntfu ngebantfu.

Ngalelinye lilanga, intfombatana lebitwa nguNomsa yahamba waya emfuleni kute ayotfola emanti. Endleleni, wahlangana nemuntfu lowagula. Wambuta: "Kutsiwa kunjani, Mkhulu? Ungakwati kuhamba?"

"Nami ngingakwati kuhamba," kuphendula lowo muntfu. "Ngidiniwe futsi ngilambe kakhulu."

Nomsa wakhumbula umtsetfo weUbuntfu. Wabeka emanti emhlabatsini, wakhuluma nalowo muntfu. "Ngiphe sikhatsi, Mkhulu, ngitawubita bantfu labanye."

Wagijima waya emkhatsini wekaya. Watsi: "Make, babe! Kunemuntfu lolambe emfuleni. Asime size."

Bantfu bakuleso sigodzi bahlangana. Bapheka kudla, baletsa emanti, bakha indlu yekugcina loyo muntfu. Nomsa wagcina loyo muntfu ahlantekile.

Ngemalanga lamanyenti, loyo muntfu waphila. Watsi: "Nomsa, ubuntfu bakho bukhulu kakhulu. Ngifundzile kutsi bantfu labahle bakhona."

Nomsa wamoyitela. Wati: "Mkhulu, ubuntfu akusiko kupha nje. Ubuntfu kukubona loko lokunye lokuhle ebantfwini. Sonkhe siyingxenye yalomndeni lomkhulu, umndeni webantfu."

## Tindlela Tekufundza

1. **Ubuntfu** — Umuntfu ngumuntfu ngebantfu. Sonkhe siyahlobana.
2. **Kuhle kwemoya** — Ngesikhatsi sisita labanye, siyatisita natsi.
3. **Kuhlangana** — Lapho sihlangene, sinemandla lamanyenti.
